EXT.evidence: She engages in assertive, social table talk and challenges the opponent: “I’ll see you and raise you… what do you say? Do you want to waste another buck?”

AGR.evidence: She is confrontational and taunting—refuses to show her cards, says “Get your hands out of my cards,” and mocks the opponent’s inability to lose and reddening face.

CON.evidence: No clear signs of organization or carelessness beyond normal poker behavior; protecting her cards is standard.

NEU.evidence: She appears confident and unbothered—raising the bet and teasing the opponent without any nervousness.

OPN.evidence: No concrete signs of curiosity or imaginative thinking; it’s routine poker banter.
